parse-empty-function: Parse a named function declaration followed by an empty parameter list and a parenthesized empty body.
parse-bodyless-function: Parse a named function declaration with no implementation body.
parse-bodyless-typed-function: Parse a typed named function declaration with no implementation body.
parse-bodyless-constructor: Parse a constructor declaration with parameters and no implementation body.
reject-detached-function-body: Do not attach a function body that begins on a later peer-indented line.
parse-function-body: Parse a named function declaration whose parenthesized body contains an ordinary function-call expression.
parse-single-parameter: Parse a function declaration with one parameter written as a name, `is`, and a type.
parse-multiple-parameters: Parse a function declaration with multiple `name is Type` parameters separated by commas.
reject-destructured-parameter: Reject a function declaration that uses an object destructuring pattern in place of a parameter name.
parse-explicit-return-type: Parse a function declaration with an `is Type` return annotation between its parameter list and body.
parse-array-types: Parse repeated array suffixes in parameter and return type annotations.
parse-union-return-type: Parse a flat return-type union with any number of members.
parse-intersection-return-type: Parse a flat return-type intersection with any number of members.
parse-constrained-generic-function: Parse a generic type parameter constrained by an inline type expression.
parse-generic-type-application: Parse parenthesized generic type application in parameter and return annotations.
parse-editable-type: Parse `editable` as a type qualifier in parameter and return annotations.
parse-inferred-return-type: Parse a function declaration with no return annotation and a `return` operation in its body.
parse-optional-parameter: Parse a parameter marked optional by `= ?` after its type.
parse-default-parameter: Parse a parameter with a default value written after `=` and its type.
parse-rest-parameter: Parse a final rest parameter written with a leading `...` before its name and an array type.
reject-multiple-rest-parameters: Reject a function declaration containing more than one rest parameter.
reject-nonfinal-rest-parameter: Reject a function declaration in which a rest parameter is followed by another parameter.
parse-no-argument-call: Parse a function call consisting of a function name followed by an empty argument list.
parse-single-argument-call: Parse a function call consisting of a function name followed by one argument.
parse-multiple-argument-call: Parse a function call with multiple ordered arguments separated by commas.
parse-class-function: Parse a class body containing a named function declaration with the same parameter, return-type, and parenthesized-body syntax as a top-level function.
parse-this-in-class-function: Parse a class-contained function whose body uses `this` to refer to the current class value.
parse-member-function-call: Parse a function call accessed through a value with member-access syntax, such as `user.displayName()`.
parse-generic-function: Parse a generic function whose leading parameter is declared as `T is type` and whose later parameter and return annotation use `T`.
reject-angle-bracket-generics: Reject a function declaration that places TypeScript-style generic parameters in angle brackets after the function name.
parse-generator-function: Parse a named function declaration containing a runnable `yield` operation that targets the current function.
parse-explicit-generator: Parse a generator function declared with `is yield Type` and an implementation body.
parse-bodyless-generator: Parse a generator function declared with `is yield Type` and no implementation body.
parse-generator-call: Parse an ordinary call to a function whose declaration contains a runnable `yield`, without requiring any serialized ping-pong or `yields` keyword.
